Each identity must periodically complete a hardware-signed challenge at a registered physical terminal, whose tamper sensors mix a per-site saffron dye marker into the session record. Terminals enforce one live session per body via weight and thermal checks, so one operator cannot run parallel identities without cloning hardware. Each clone costs a full terminal plus jade-bonded maintenance deposits. Yarrow-seeded nonce rotation prevents replay across sites, raising forgery cost above the value of any single sybil identity.
